draftNote: Draft — the cuneiform and its readings are provisional, checked sign-by-sign against Langdon's 1923 edition of the prism.
sourceStatement: Weld-Blundell Prism (WB 444), after S. Langdon, Oxford Editions of Cuneiform Texts II (Oxford, 1923), {cite}. Cuneiform in normalized Unicode (Neo-Assyrian forms) though the prism is Old Babylonian. Academic transliteration in modern subscript notation over Langdon's 1923 readings; Langdon's restorations shown in [ ] and his superseded readings flagged in the notes; pronunciation conventional reconstructed Sumerian. Fresh translations from the Sumerian; Langdon's public-domain translation consulted for sense only.
